scenarios.role: read-only audit of boundedness, duplicate meaning, stale paths, provenance visibility, public hygiene, and owner route
default_validation: targeted validator for the audited surface when one is named
scenarios.done_signal: audit findings are scoped, evidenced, and routed to the correct memory source, mechanic, validator, or sibling owner
scenarios.stop_line: do not rewrite the audited surface during audit-only work

scenarios.role: one small source-backed patch to an existing memory surface
default_validation: targeted owner-surface validator when one is named
scenarios.done_signal: one existing memory surface is more explicit, provenance-aware, temporally honest, and bounded
scenarios.stop_line: stop when the patch asks for proof, route policy, role authority, KAG meaning, runtime state, or a second owner

scenarios.role: inspect recall, retention, checkpoint, adoption, or recurrence contracts for temporal and provenance clarity
default_validation: targeted mechanic validator when the contract is mechanic-local
scenarios.done_signal: recall claim, source, temporal posture, salience limit, and validator route are explicit
scenarios.stop_line: do not turn a recall contract into proof of current truth, identity, role right, or dispatch authority

scenarios.role: compare source, builder, generated companion, and validator without treating generated output as truth
default_validation: builder --check command named by the generated surface
matching validator named by the generated surface
scenarios.done_signal: source, builder, generated output, and validation route agree or the mismatch is routed
scenarios.stop_line: do not hand-edit generated companions as source truth

scenarios.role: map one mechanic seam, legacy bridge, owner map, part-local artifact, or validation route before deeper mechanic work
scenarios.done_signal: likely active home, legacy route, stronger owner, part-local artifact home, and next validator are named
scenarios.stop_line: do not move mechanic artifacts or author mechanic law during scout-only work

scenarios.role: review a concrete diff or PR for memory-layer risk and missed checks
scenarios.done_signal: findings are ordered by severity and tied to exact paths, validators, and owner routes
scenarios.stop_line: do not rewrite the diff while acting as reviewer

scenarios.role: align Spark docs, registry, validator, tests, release gate, and generated companions
scenarios.done_signal: Spark source, registry, docs, validator, release gate, and generated mesh agree
scenarios.stop_line: do not create a new source of truth while syncing derived routes

scenarios.role: add bounded tests for an already clear memory contract
default_validation: targeted unittest or pytest command for the changed test directory
owning source-surface validator when one is named
scenarios.done_signal: tests prove a named existing memory contract and pass locally
scenarios.stop_line: do not invent new memory semantics to make tests interesting

scenarios.role: run a fast release-readiness pass without publishing
scenarios.done_signal: changed surfaces, checks, public-claim risks, generated parity, and owner routes are named
scenarios.stop_line: do not publish, tag, push, or merge without an explicit user command
